Record Class AtomicConfiguration

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.AtomicConfiguration
Record Components:
atomicNumber - the atomic number (number of protons)
neutrons - the number of neutrons
charge - the net electrical charge
electronShells - an immutable list of electron counts per shell
public record AtomicConfiguration(int atomicNumber, int neutrons, int charge, List<Integer> electronShells) extends Record
Describes one atom's nucleus, charge, and electron shells.

For example, a neutral carbon-12 atom has 6 protons, 6 neutrons, and shell counts of 2 and 4. Electron paths in the viewer are schematic, rather than a simulation of electron motion.
